# Title: Uncertainty in chronic migraine forecasting

## Keywords
chronic migraine, symptom variability, clinical forecasting

## TL;DR
How can useful warning signals remain reliable as symptoms and daily conditions change?

## Abstract
Chronic migraine creates an uneven burden whose timing and severity vary within and across people. Research can characterize uncertainty, identify broadly informative observations, and compare distinct forecasting and care-support strategies without presupposing a particular sensing setup or intervention.
